info.title: IPS Support API — design contract
info.description: Design only. M5 operations are optional extensions. No server implemented yet.

get.description: Read the current ticket for an owned conversation. Select an active ticket first, then the most recent resolved or closed ticket by lifecycle time. For an owned conversation without tickets, return ticket: null. Use the authenticated customer, widget and organization and enforce conversation scope. Reading never creates or reopens a ticket.

MessageInput.description: attachment_ids optional, M5 only, at most 4 authorized ready images; text remains required in v1.

ErrorResponse.description: Domain, authorization, validation, quota or availability error
